//: Vercel is serverless, so this file plays the part nginx plays under Docker:
it decides what serves each path. web/index.html is served from the CDN and
everything the browser calls -- /api/* and /health -- is routed to the one
Node function in api/index.js, which is the Express app itself.
`builds` is used rather than zero-config detection on purpose. Zero-config
turns every file in a root-level api/ directory into its own function, which
would also publish api/server.js at /api/server. Declaring the entrypoints
explicitly keeps the surface to exactly one function.
